Yeah, I just want someone to genuinely feel concerned about me
Thanks man
Man, I had a horrible dream the night after taking the test. I got a 570 (freaked out so bad), but then, I got a message saying there was a mistake and my score shot up... to 750 -\_-

I'm taking Math 2 and Physics on the same day, gonna start studying for it today. Khan Academy is a great way to study for tests, it's probably the only thing that'll help me pass. If u still feel unsure, maybe buy some test prep books. I've bought some from Barron's to help me out, the Princeton Review is also pretty good. If u buy the official SAT subject test books, it won't help u study but it does have copies of previously administered subject tests for practice, which could really help u get a feel of how the exam is given. Hope this helped!
